review_status: broad independent sanity comparison; convention differences retained
conventions: USNO uses solar centre zenith distance 90.8333 degrees (average 16 arcminute radius plus 34 arcminute refraction), sea level. KRIPA uses Swiss upper limb with actual radius and atmosphere 1013.25 hPa/15 C. Both report upper-limb events but are not identical models. Two-minute tolerance allows minute-rounded reference and model differences; not a physical accuracy guarantee.
